messages:
Marta C: Quick proposal — switch admission control to a hybrid mode: short per-request queue (<= 250ms) + degrade low-priority best-effort tenants to CPU-only when queue overflow. Want feedback before rolling.

Raj P: Short queue seems good to keep P50 low. How do we decide "low-priority"? per-customer SLA tag? per-route?

Liang Z: We'll need per-region caps. EU-west already at 92% GPU saturation; short queue there will just push rejections unless degrade path exists.

Noah S: Suggest policy: keep queue length window <= 20 requests per GPU node; if exceeded, try degrade candidates (priority <= 1) and then reject. Also fair-share via token-bucket per-tenant.

Marta C: Sketch config:
```
admit_policy:
  mode: hybrid
  max_queue_ms: 250
  max_queue_len_per_node: 20
  degrade_path: cpu_fallback
  degrade_priority_threshold: 1
  token_bucket: {rate: 50req/s, burst: 100}
```

Raj P: Token bucket per-tenant is good but we should also reserve guaranteed slots for enterprise customers (SLA). Maybe a two-tier bucket: reserved + shared pool.

InfraBot: [metric snapshot] region: eu-west gpu_util: 92.3% queue_len_1m: 18 p99_lat: 490ms

Liang Z: +1 reserved slots. Also need circuit-breaker on network errors — we've seen cascading RPC latencies when we push to cpu_fallback.

Noah S: Can we simulate with chaos runs? I'll add a canary: 5% traffic, observability hooks for per-tenant dropped/degraded counts.

Marta C: Nice. Action items: Noah to submit canary PR + config; Raj to design two-tier bucket; Liang to add region capacity guard rails. We'll meetup at 11 tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Raj P: ACK

Noah S: on it
